title: Direction angle convention
text: With east $$=$$ $$+x$$ and north $$=$$ $$+y$$, $$"55\degree$$ $$south$$ $$of$$ $$east"$$ $$means$$ $$55\degree$$ $$below$$ $$the$$ $$+x$$ axis, so $$\theta_A=-55**\circ$$.

title: Draw a triangle
text: Draw a right triangle with hypotenuse $$\vec{A}$$ and the two legs the $$x-$$ and $$y-$$ components. Label the angle and use trigonometry to find the components.
